newsitem.title: ITALY: Zaire air crash kills four, including two priests.
newsitem.headline: Zaire air crash kills four, including two priests.

text.p: Four people were killed, including two priests, when a light aircraft smashed into a mountainside in eastern Zaire last Saturday, a Roman Catholic missionary order in Italy said on Thursday.
The five-seater TMK aircraft was on a flight from Kampene to Bukavu on Zaire's border with Rwanda when it ran into trouble in a storm, the Xaverian Fathers said in a statement.
It identified the dead as Italian Xaverian father Giovanni Tumino, 51, a 65-year-old Zairean priest, Abbe Cimanuka, the Greek pilot and a commercial traveller whose nationality was not given.
The statement said the wreckage had been found by the head of a local Christian mission in Kigulube on Monday. The dead were buried in the area by the mission, it said.
